review_kind: post-hoc input/measurement review for an already completed run; not a pre-dispatch approval

window_scope.verification_classification: post-cutoff run; preserve as NativeOnly diagnostic, not as within-window result

runner_review.venv_import_fix: adds the official venv site-packages for the host Python ABI; asserts the directory exists
runner_review.queue_guard: compares current time to the artifact plan cutoff; plan cutoff was changed to the round end, allowing the 09:52 runner start
runner_review.target_and_flags: same single owned native target, original MainExact byte-copy assertion, raw compile/link/response flag equality checks
runner_review.reference_and_candidate: full original proof only on retained reference; candidate remains intake/policy plus native target, unproved
runner_review.measurement: original quick config/generator/run_binary; 30 cells x 6 workloads, two root seeds, five rounds, alternating pair order and checksum assert
runner_review.proof_diagnostics: measure=false raw VerifyExact statement logs only; not full gate or helper acceptance

reference_scope: retained only; no direct originalshipped pair
score_claim_boundary: If all raw data validates, score is post-cutoff NativeOnly exploration against retained; not proof, promotion, or current-champion comparison.
